title: How the French left wants to reclaim the idea of the nation
subhead: Although the concept of the nation was born during the French Revolution, the far right has claimed it since the end of the 20th century. Nevertheless, the left has never completely abandoned patriotism. The current presidential campaign proves as much.

title: France investigates Thales contracts in Azerbaijan denounced by jailed former employee
subhead: 'A forgotten Frenchman in Baku' (2/2). Mehmet Sahan, a French-Turkish dual national detained in Azerbaijan since early 2022 after a complaint by Thales, has alleged corruption. French prosecutors, who searched the premises of the defense giant in 2024, are investigating the contracts in question.

title: How Jeffrey Epstein used Woody Allen to expand his network
subhead: The millions of documents released by the US Department of Justice reveal that Jeffrey Epstein invested significant amounts of money and energy in building his friendship with filmmaker Woody Allen. subhead: The 35-year-old has established himself on Twitch as one of the most-followed political commentators in the US. title: 'The Trump plan changed nothing': One year later, Gaza still lives in ruins, under bombs
subhead: Three years after the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, residents of the Palestinian territory continue to live among rubble. The plan brokered under the auspices of the American president on October 10, 2025 has stalled, and despite the ceasefire it provides for, Israel's campaign of destruction has continued.

title: Letter from imprisoned Russian journalist Ivan Safronov: 'Like Jean Valjean, I know what captivity is, and I know how to cherish freedom'
